growthFormula: Growth = PO value (Oct 2025–Sep 2026) ÷ PO value (Oct 2024–Sep 2025) − 1, per country × product, on de-duplicated customers (golden IDs). SGD across products; units within a product.
measureNote: PO value in SGD (fixed illustrative FX) for cross-product totals; PO units within a product. Confirmed customer POs only.
cleaningNote: Merging duplicate customers alone does not change country × product totals. Only the misattributed (SG-coded records for MY/VN hospitals, from Jan 2026) and miscategorised (TH reagent kits coded as consumables) volume moves between cells.
